description: This Java source file defines the TenantClientImpl class, which implements the TenantClient interface. It provides methods to interact with Hono's Tenant API over AMQP, including retrieving tenant information by ID or subject DN, creating client links, handling caching, and managing responses. The class uses Vertx Proton for AMQP communication, JSON processing with Jackson, and integrates with tracing and logging frameworks.
